faq.title: Questions? I've Got Answers
faq.a1: Each lesson is 60 minutes of focused, personalized instruction built around YOUR goals and YOUR pace.
faq.a2: I teach via Zoom, Skype, or WhatsApp video call - whatever works best for YOU. Your comfort = better learning.
faq.a3: Absolutely! Book a free 30-minute consultation and let's discuss your goals. No pressure, just honest conversation about how I can help.
faq.q4: How quickly will I see results?
faq.a4: Most of my students notice significant improvement within 4-6 weeks with consistent practice. BUT - everyone's journey is different. I'll help you set realistic goals.
faq.a5: I'll provide all course materials digitally. You just need a device with internet access and the motivation to improve. That's it!
faq.a6: Life happens - I get it! With 24-hour notice, you can reschedule lessons to fit YOUR schedule. Flexibility matters.
